assessment.diagnostic_midpoints_as_eligibility_basi: no bypass found; unresolved hits take precedence and pair remains UNKNOWN
assessment.numeric_overflow: vector, hypot length, uncertainty band and doubled threshold, interval widths, interpolation points, and output fields have structured finite guards; tests check JSON allow_nan=false
assessment.recommended_next_step: Root may authorize one bounded pytest command in design_and_freeze.md after review. This is a module check only, not asset admission or physical PASS.

findings.finding: The ledger still reports native graph disconnected and whole_asset_physics_status=NOT_ASSESSED; backend/assets do not call the classifier. No asset-level rejection rule exists for UNKNOWN in critical regions, and no post-filter neighbor/bond/correction/kernel/storage graph is verified.
findings.impact: A successful pair ledger cannot admit a real vessel to native solving.

findings.finding: Half-sum midpoint is stable for huge same-sign inputs but underflows for the smallest positive subnormal: _safe_midpoint(x,x) becomes 0 for x=5e-324. A singleton exact hit at that parameter can move to t=0, be omitted as a cut, and evade tangent detection because no interval ends before the moved event. Under mocked IN endpoint/midpoint states this path can reach IN_MATERIAL; actual OCC behavior at this scale is unverified and internal tolerances may force ON.
findings.recommendation: Return low when low==high; return UNKNOWN when a strict representable midpoint does not exist or the tolerance is below coordinate resolution. Add a pure-math and state-control regression.

findings.finding: Source accuracy/basis remains a caller assertion; OCC subshape tolerances are not read or compared. The actual STEP bytes are compared with caller-supplied expected_sha256, but no trusted manifest binds that digest and candidate point set to the vessel asset.
findings.impact: UNKNOWN/native admission remains external; an understated accuracy declaration or wrong self-pinned STEP can still be reported as a valid source for that caller-provided geometry.

findings.finding: Invalid source_accuracy_basis adds an UNKNOWN reason but is stored and emitted unchanged. If it is float NaN, result serialization with allow_nan=false fails although geometry is fail-closed.
findings.recommendation: Normalize invalid basis to None and add a strict JSON regression.

findings.finding: No actual CAD/pytest run was performed. Correct handling of tangent, coincident, shared-edge/vertex and incomplete all-hit results remains dependent on the exact OCC runtime. IsDone=True with NbPnt=0 still yields one midpoint-classified interval, so endpoint/midpoint IN can be eligible if an intersection is missed.
findings.recommendation: The bounded hollow-shell/coupon run is the right first check; later add an endpoints-inside tangent path, coincident path, and shared-edge/vertex controls before real asset use.

test_review.chain_controls: Tests assert multi-parameter clusters and short-cavity mocked-IN intervals remain UNKNOWN, diagnostic-only, and noneligible.
test_review.numeric_controls: Tests cover uncertainty sum/doubled threshold overflow, extreme endpoint-vector overflow, large hit midpoint, and allow_nan=false serialization; they do not exercise subnormal midpoint, hypot near the largest finite length, or extreme interpolation directly.
test_review.execution_status: Tests are source only and remain unrun.

v1_design_hash_discrepancy.explanation: The prior review pin refers to the live v1 draft it read; the v1 archive manifest preserves different design bytes. The 1e943 bytes are not present in the archive, so exact textual delta cannot be recovered. The archive was left unchanged.
